instructions: Read each workplace scenario and choose how you would naturally prefer to respond.

scenarios.situation: Your team is facing a tight deadline, and there's disagreement about the approach.

responses.label: A) Take charge and make a decisive call to keep moving forward

feedbackTemplates.high: This aligns perfectly with your high dominance! You naturally take charge in pressure situations and make quick decisions to drive results.
feedbackTemplates.moderate: This shows some dominance tendencies. You can be decisive when needed, though you might also consider collaborative approaches.
feedbackTemplates.low: This approach requires high dominance. With your lower D score, you might prefer a more collaborative or methodical decision-making process.

responses.label: B) Bring the team together to discuss concerns and build consensus
responses.description: Ensure everyone feels heard and motivated

feedbackTemplates.high: Great choice for your high influence! You value team harmony and ensuring everyone is on board before moving forward.
feedbackTemplates.moderate: This reflects moderate influence. You appreciate collaboration but might also be comfortable with quicker decision-making.
feedbackTemplates.low: This collaborative approach may feel draining if you have lower influence and prefer working more independently.

responses.label: C) Suggest a structured plan with clear roles to reduce conflict

feedbackTemplates.high: This aligns with your high steadiness! You naturally want to reduce conflict and create a stable, organized approach.
feedbackTemplates.moderate: This shows some steadiness. You value structure but can also be flexible when urgency requires it.
feedbackTemplates.low: With lower steadiness, you might actually prefer a more flexible, fast-moving approach rather than detailed planning.

responses.label: D) Analyze all options thoroughly before deciding on the best path

feedbackTemplates.high: Perfect for your high conscientiousness! You want to ensure the decision is well-thought-out and quality-focused.
feedbackTemplates.moderate: This reflects moderate conscientiousness. You value analysis but can balance it with timely decision-making.
feedbackTemplates.low: This detailed analysis approach may feel slower than you prefer if you have lower conscientiousness and like to move quickly.

scenarios.situation: A colleague comes to you upset about a work issue. How do you respond?

responses.label: A) Focus on finding a solution to fix the problem
responses.description: Address the issue directly and efficiently

feedbackTemplates.high: Your high dominance drives you to solve problems quickly and take action. You want to fix issues, not just talk about them.
feedbackTemplates.moderate: You balance problem-solving with empathy. You can fix issues while also considering feelings.
feedbackTemplates.low: You might naturally focus more on the emotional aspect before jumping to solutions.

responses.label: B) Listen empathetically and help them process their feelings

feedbackTemplates.high: Your high influence makes you naturally empathetic. You excel at providing emotional support and building rapport.
feedbackTemplates.moderate: You can provide support while also thinking practically about solutions.
feedbackTemplates.low: You might find extended emotional discussions less comfortable and prefer to focus on facts.

responses.label: C) Offer consistent support and reassurance

feedbackTemplates.high: Your high steadiness makes you an excellent listener and supportive colleague. You provide calm, patient support.
feedbackTemplates.moderate: You can be supportive while also encouraging action when appropriate.
feedbackTemplates.low: You might prefer to help them move forward quickly rather than dwelling on the issue.

responses.label: D) Help them analyze the situation objectively

feedbackTemplates.high: Your high conscientiousness drives you to understand issues thoroughly. You help by bringing logic and analysis.
feedbackTemplates.moderate: You balance analytical thinking with emotional awareness.
feedbackTemplates.low: You might find it easier to address emotions first before analyzing the situation.

scenarios.situation: Your manager asks you to present your project progress to senior leadership.

responses.label: A) Jump at the opportunity to showcase results
responses.description: Confident and eager to demonstrate impact

feedbackTemplates.high: Your high dominance makes you confident in high-stakes situations. You see this as an opportunity to shine and drive results.
feedbackTemplates.moderate: You're comfortable presenting when needed but might prepare carefully first.
feedbackTemplates.low: You might feel some nervousness and prefer to have strong support and preparation.

responses.label: B) Prepare an engaging presentation that tells a compelling story
responses.description: Focus on connecting with the audience

feedbackTemplates.high: Your high influence helps you connect with audiences. You naturally create engaging, persuasive presentations.
feedbackTemplates.moderate: You can be engaging while also staying focused on facts and results.
feedbackTemplates.low: You might prefer to stick to facts and data rather than storytelling.

responses.label: C) Feel nervous but prepare thoroughly to ensure success

feedbackTemplates.high: Your high steadiness means you prefer predictable situations. You'll prepare carefully to manage the stress of presenting.
feedbackTemplates.moderate: You balance preparation with confidence. Some nervousness is natural but manageable.
feedbackTemplates.low: You might feel less anxiety and be more comfortable with spontaneity in presentations.

responses.label: D) Create detailed slides with comprehensive data and analysis

feedbackTemplates.high: Your high conscientiousness drives you to prepare meticulously. You want every detail to be accurate and well-supported.
feedbackTemplates.moderate: You balance detail with high-level messaging, providing both depth and clarity.
feedbackTemplates.low: You might prefer a simpler, high-level presentation rather than diving into all the details.

scenarios.situation: You're offered a new role that's outside your comfort zone but has growth potential.

responses.label: A) See it as an exciting challenge and accept immediately

feedbackTemplates.high: Your high dominance loves challenges! You're energized by new opportunities and confident in your ability to succeed.
feedbackTemplates.moderate: You see the opportunity but want to assess the risks and benefits first.
feedbackTemplates.low: You might be more cautious and want to ensure you're well-prepared before accepting.

responses.label: B) Get excited and talk to others about the possibilities

feedbackTemplates.high: Your high influence makes you enthusiastic about new opportunities! You process decisions by talking them through with others.
feedbackTemplates.moderate: You enjoy discussing opportunities but also think independently about what's right for you.
feedbackTemplates.low: You might prefer to think through the decision more privately before discussing it widely.

responses.label: C) Feel uncertain and need time to consider all implications

feedbackTemplates.high: Your high steadiness makes you cautious about change. You need time to process and ensure this is the right move.
feedbackTemplates.moderate: You balance consideration with openness to new opportunities.
feedbackTemplates.low: You're more comfortable with change and might be ready to decide quickly.

responses.label: D) Research the role thoroughly and create a pros/cons list

feedbackTemplates.high: Your high conscientiousness drives you to analyze thoroughly. You want all the information before making such an important decision.
feedbackTemplates.moderate: You gather key information while also trusting your intuition.
feedbackTemplates.low: You might be more comfortable making decisions based on gut feel rather than extensive analysis.

scenarios.situation: Your team's weekly meeting often runs over time and lacks clear outcomes.

responses.label: A) Take control and push for clear agenda and decisions

feedbackTemplates.high: Your high dominance is frustrated by inefficiency! You naturally want to take charge and make meetings more productive.
feedbackTemplates.moderate: You appreciate efficiency but might balance this with allowing some flexibility for discussion.
feedbackTemplates.low: You might be more comfortable letting the meeting flow naturally, even if it's less structured.

responses.label: B) Suggest making meetings more engaging and collaborative

feedbackTemplates.high: Your high influence values engagement! You want meetings to be energizing and collaborative, not just efficient.
feedbackTemplates.moderate: You balance engagement with productivity, wanting both connection and results.
feedbackTemplates.low: You might prefer shorter, more focused meetings with less social interaction.

responses.label: C) Continue attending but wish for more structure

feedbackTemplates.high: Your high steadiness makes you patient with imperfect processes. You're uncomfortable rocking the boat.
feedbackTemplates.moderate: You can speak up for improvements while being diplomatic about it.
feedbackTemplates.low: You're more likely to push for change directly rather than waiting and hoping.

responses.label: D) Create a detailed meeting template with clear objectives

feedbackTemplates.high: Your high conscientiousness drives you to create structure and systems. You want meetings to be organized and purposeful.
feedbackTemplates.moderate: You appreciate structure but can also be flexible when creativity requires less rigidity.
feedbackTemplates.low: You might prefer a simpler approach rather than creating detailed templates.

scenarios.situation: You notice a mistake in a process that could impact quality, but fixing it would slow things down.

responses.label: A) Decide if the impact is worth the delay, prioritizing speed

feedbackTemplates.high: Your high dominance prioritizes results and momentum. You'll fix critical issues but won't let small problems derail progress.
feedbackTemplates.moderate: You balance quality and speed, fixing what's important while maintaining momentum.
feedbackTemplates.low: You might be more inclined to fix things thoroughly even if it takes longer.

responses.label: B) Discuss with the team to get buy-in before making changes

feedbackTemplates.high: Your high influence values team input. You want everyone aligned before making process changes.
feedbackTemplates.moderate: You gather input but can also make decisions independently when needed.
feedbackTemplates.low: You might prefer to analyze and fix the issue yourself rather than involving many people.

responses.label: C) Feel torn but follow the established process

feedbackTemplates.high: Your high steadiness values consistency and established processes. You're uncomfortable making changes that could cause disruption.
feedbackTemplates.moderate: You respect processes but can advocate for necessary changes.
feedbackTemplates.low: You're more comfortable disrupting the process to fix issues quickly.

responses.label: D) Insist on fixing it properly regardless of timeline

feedbackTemplates.high: Your high conscientiousness won't compromise on quality! You believe fixing mistakes properly is essential, even if it takes longer.
feedbackTemplates.moderate: You value quality but can prioritize based on impact and urgency.
feedbackTemplates.low: You might be more comfortable with 'good enough' solutions that allow you to keep moving forward.

scenarios.situation: You have the option to work on a high-visibility project that requires learning new skills quickly.

responses.label: A) Jump in confidently, figuring it out as you go

feedbackTemplates.high: Your high dominance makes you confident taking on challenges! You're comfortable learning on the fly and trust your ability to figure things out.
feedbackTemplates.moderate: You're willing to learn new things but might want some preparation first.
feedbackTemplates.low: You might prefer to build expertise before taking on high-visibility challenges.

responses.label: B) Network with people who can teach you and support you

feedbackTemplates.high: Your high influence leverages relationships for learning! You're excited to connect with experts and learn collaboratively.
feedbackTemplates.moderate: You'll seek help when needed but also learn independently.
feedbackTemplates.low: You might prefer to learn through documentation or solo practice rather than asking many people for help.

responses.label: C) Take it on only if you have adequate support and training

feedbackTemplates.high: Your high steadiness wants assurance before tackling unfamiliar territory. You need support and training to feel comfortable.
feedbackTemplates.moderate: You want some preparation but can also tolerate some uncertainty.
feedbackTemplates.low: You're more comfortable diving into new things without extensive preparation.

responses.label: D) Study thoroughly before committing to the project

feedbackTemplates.high: Your high conscientiousness wants to be well-prepared! You'll thoroughly study the requirements before committing.
feedbackTemplates.moderate: You'll do some preparation but are also comfortable learning as you go.
feedbackTemplates.low: You might prefer to learn through doing rather than extensive upfront study.
